claims.text: Philip Noel-Baker won the silver medal in the men's 1,500 metres at the 1920 Antwerp Olympics.
Philip Noel-Baker won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1959.
Noel-Baker did not win the Nobel Prize in Physics, a Pulitzer Prize or the Booker Prize, which was first awarded in 1969.
The 1959 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Noel-Baker 'for his longstanding contribution to the cause of disarmament and peace'.
Philip Noel-Baker was a British politician.
